shortDescription: RNS Number : 0196B  Eurowag  29 October 2026   W.A.G payment solutions plc(the "Company" or "Eurowag")Name ChangeW.A.G payment solutions plc announces that the board of directors has resolved, in accordance with the Company's Articles of Association, to change the Company's name to 'Eurowag Group'…

children: W.A.G payment solutions plc announces that the board of directors has resolved, in accordance with the Company's Articles of Association, to change the Company's name to 'Eurowag Group' plc to reflect its transition from a provider of payments and mobility solutions to an integrated digital platform business, bringing together mission-critical services for the commercial road transport industry.

The name change is expected to be confirmed shortly. A further announcement will be made once the name change is effective and a change of name certificate has been received from the Registrar of Companies.

Eurowag is a leading technology company serving Europe's commercial road transport ("CRT") industry, with a purpose to make it clean, fair and efficient. Eurowag Office is the first integrated digital platform for the European CRT industry, bringing together mission-critical services across Fuel, Toll, Financial Services, Navigation, Fleet and Work Time Management. By connecting its technology, infrastructure and industry expertise through a single platform, Eurowag helps transport companies simplify complex operations, make better decisions and run more efficient and profitable businesses. Eurowag is listed on the London Stock Exchange
and is a constituent of the FTSE 250. investors.eurowag.com
